headword: {功|こう}{成|な}り{名|な}{遂|と}げる
gloss: to achieve fame and success; to attain distinction; to make a name for oneself

definitions.gloss: to achieve fame and success; to attain distinction
definitions.explanation: Formal or literary expression meaning to accomplish great things and build a lasting reputation. Often used in biographies, formal speeches, and writing about notable achievements.

examples.japanese: {功|こう}{成|な}り{名|な}{遂|と}げた⟦{実業家|じつぎょうか}→実業家：12294_jitsugyouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自伝|じでん}→自伝：25302_jiden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the autobiography of a businessman who had achieved fame and success.

examples.japanese: {功|こう}{成|な}り{名|な}{遂|と}げた⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初心|しょしん}→初心：08656_shoshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れなかった→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Even after achieving fame and success, she never forgot her original aspirations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、ついに{功|こう}{成|な}り{名|な}{遂|と}げる{時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: After years of effort, the time to achieve fame and success finally came.

notes:
Formal/literary expression. Composed of 功成り ({功|こう} merit/achievement + ⟦なり→なり：09883_nari⟧ becoming/succeeding) and 名遂げる (⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧ name/fame + 遂げる to accomplish).

Often appears as 功成り名遂げた (past tense, as a modifier) or 功成り名遂げた後 (after achieving success).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 成功⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: to achieve success — general
- {大成|たいせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to achieve great things; to become a great person
- ⟦{名声|めいせい}→名声：05512_meisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain fame
